Source: http://rxcbc.org/

Posted March 2, 2000
(MarijuanaNews note: This is a major victory for medical marijuana. Congratulations to my good friends, Jeff Jones and Robert Raich.)

March 2, 2000

From Robert Raich, Attorney for Oakland Cannabis Buyers' Cooperative:

I am pleased to report that the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals has handed another victory to the Oakland Cannabis Buyers' Cooperative, voting to DENY the Clinton Administration's petition for rehearing and rehearing en banc.

Regardless of whether the Clinton Administration appeals to the U.S. Supreme Court, we expect to be back soon before the district court seeking a ruling that our patients meet the federal " medical necessity " standard.
